dialog.deltaPlaceholder: Enter a non-zero integer (+ to add, - to deduct)
dialog.deltaHint: Positive values add to total and remaining quota; negative values can only deduct from remaining quota (max deduction {maxDecrease}) without borrowing reserved or used quota.
dialog.projected: Estimated after change: Total {total} / Remaining {remaining} (subject to server audit)
dialog.adjustEvidencePlaceholder: Enter ticket ID, approval reference, or reconciliation notes
dialog.resolveEvidencePlaceholder: Enter verified supplier ticket ID, receipt number, or manual verification record
dialog.expectedIpPlaceholder: Enter the new IP confirmed on supplier receipt
dialog.verificationWarningBody: Missing records, lookup failures, or an unchanged old IP are NOT valid proof of non-execution. Complete actual supplier verification and provide valid evidence rather than assuming outcomes from the UI.
dialog.correctionWarningBody: Use only to correct a previously resolved record with a late conflict. The server validates and protects newer configurations.
dialog.pendingIntentTitle: Previous request had no definitive response; original payload is locked
dialog.pendingIntentBody: Fields are locked to prevent reusing the same request key with changed parameters. Click "Retry Original Request" to replay the exact request; the lock clears only after a 2xx success or an explicit 4xx rejection.
dialog.adjustSuccessTitle: Quota adjusted; server audit record below
dialog.correctSuccess: Conflict correction submitted and data refreshed.
